definitions.explanation: The arrangement and organization of parts in a system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構造|こうぞう}
⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{構造|こうぞう}
⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構造|こうぞう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ともに→共に：03468_tomoni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦してきた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The structure of society has changed greatly over time.

notes:
{構造|こうぞう} refers to the internal arrangement of parts that make up a whole — how something is built or organized. It applies to physical objects, systems, and abstract concepts alike.

COMPOUNDS:
- {構造|こうぞう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: structural (as a na-adjective)
- {構造|こうぞう}⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧: structural reform
- {構造|こうぞう}⟦{上|じょう}→上：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: structural problem
- {構造|こうぞう}⟦{物|ぶつ}→物：noentry⟧: a structure (physical)

TYPICAL DOMAINS:
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧{構造|こうぞう}: social structure
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{構造|こうぞう}: economic structure
- ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構造|こうぞう}: sentence structure
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構造|こうぞう}: building structure
